buildx.zigSimplified Zig Build System

A minimal, efficient library that wraps std.Build for Zig

Minimal API

One function to create a project. No boilerplate, no complexity.

Cross Compilation

Build for all platforms with a single config object.

Workspace Support

Monorepo support with local dependencies between packages.

System Libraries

Link system libraries with automatic libc/libcpp handling.

Custom Options

Define build-time options with type-safe defaults.

Full std.Build Access

Returns *Step.Compile so you can customize further with std.Build.
